title: PII quarantine saga and legal-ready audit ledger
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Design and implement a quarantine-first deletion saga for analytics ingestion that preserves an immutable, queryable audit ledger suitable for legal review. This ticket covers the backend components: quarantine blobstore, write‑once tombstone ledger, reconciliation jobs, a legal approval gate, short‑lived forensic export interface, and observability for deletion SLOs. Goal: enable safe selective erase and automated retention enforcement while producing auditable artifacts for compliance teams.
acceptance_criteria: All ingested records that match retention/PII rules can be moved atomically into a quarantine partition with an immutable tombstone written to the audit ledger
Reconciliation job detects and repairs mismatches between ledger and storage within configured SLAs (default 24h) and exposes actionable alerts
Legal approval flow can convert a quarantine entry to irreversible purge; all conversions are recorded in ledger with signer and timestamp
Forensic exports produce time-limited signed URLs and an access log; exports are disabled by default and require explicit RBAC grant
End-to-end tests (ingest -> quarantine -> approve -> purge) exist in CI and are exercised in a canary environment
Metrics and dashboards created: deletion_lag_seconds, tombstone_count, quarantined_bytes, audit_export_success_rate, reconcile_errors_count
work_items: Schema: define write-once tombstone ledger record (id, source_partition, reason_code, detection_rule, created_by, created_at, signature) and retention_policy metadata
Storage: provision quarantine blobstore bucket with lifecycle rules and immutability flag; support two tiers (temporary escrow vs permanent purge candidates)
Saga: implement idempotent deletion saga orchestrator with steps: mark, move-to-quarantine, write-tombstone, ack, schedule-reconcile
Reconciliation: background compare job that computes set-diff between ledger and blob index and emits repair tasks or operator tickets
Legal gate: console endpoint to list pending quarantine records with contextual artifacts and allow sign-off; sign-offs emit signed ledger events and trigger irreversible purge workflow
Forensic export: short-lived export API that streams redacted copy + export audit record; requires RBAC and MFA enforcement for high-risk tenants
Observability: instrument saga steps with tracer spans, expose histogram of deletion latencies, and add dashboard + alerting rules
Testing: unit tests for ledger invariants, integration tests for orchestrator, chaos run to simulate partial failures and validate at-least-once semantics
Docs & runbook: write operator playbook for stuck quarantines, legal request handling, and manual purge emergency path (with audit requirements)
Migration: backfill job to scan existing retention tables and backfill quarantine + tombstone for records older than retention thresholds
rollout_plan: Feature branch & initial implementation behind feature flag on canary cluster
Smoke tests: create synthetic events, assert quarantine and ledger entries
Enable reconciliation on canary for 48h; validate alerts and repair work items
Gradual rollout to staging customers (5% of traffic) with monitoring runbook on call
Open security review and legal sign-off; get RBAC controls wired
Full rollout after 2-week observation window and zero critical reconcile failures
monitoring_and_slo: Deletion SLO: 99.9% of eligible records moved to quarantine and tombstoned within 5 minutes
Reconcile SLO: 99% of ledger/storage mismatches resolved within 24 hours
Alerts: reconcile_errors_count > 10 in 1h, deletion_lag_seconds P95 > 300s, audit_export_failure_rate > 0.5%
Logs: every purge must have audit entry + signer identity + justification URI
testing_plan: Unit: ledger write is idempotent; signature verification validates created_by claims
Integration: orchestrator run-through using local blobstore emulator and ledger DB
E2E: ingest -> quarantine -> approve -> purge using canary tenant; assert metrics and audit artifacts
Backfill: run migration in dry-run mode, validate expected tombstones without purging
Chaos: kill worker mid-saga and assert at-least-once semantics and eventual consistency
security_and_compliance_notes: Ledger writes must be atomic and append-only; use KMS-backed HMAC for signature field
Forensic export requires MFA and 'legal:export' permission; exports are rate-limited and logged to WORM storage
Retention settings are per-customer and default to company retention policy; legal holds override automatic purge
Security review scheduled with AppSec on 2025-02-26 (see attachment)
GDPR/CCPA mapping doc referenced in Confluence attachment

notes: This ticket intentionally separates quarantine (recoverable escrow) from irreversible purge. Operators must follow runbook and legal sign-off before final purge.
Consider future extension: differential retention by event-type and dynamic TTLs based on customer tier
Potential optimization: prefix-hashing for quarantine bucket to make reconciliation sharding cheaper
